name: High Wire Networks, Inc.
summary: High Wire Networks, Inc. (HWNI), headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, specializes in delivering outsourced technical services to the wireless and wireline industries throughout Puerto Rico, Canada, and the United States. The company operates through two distinct segments: Technology and High Wire. HWNI provides a broad spectrum of services, including engineering, installation, and staffing solutions, as well as strategic consulting for the telecommunications and technology sectors, service providers, and various enterprise clients. Furthermore, it implements robust, end-to-end security measures designed to safeguard networks, data, endpoints, and users. Its capabilities also encompass the deployment of fiber optic and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS) in both indoor facilities and outdoor environments. The company's extensive service portfolio covers network systems design, site acquisition, asset auditing, architectural and engineering expertise, program and construction management, actual construction, installation, and continuous maintenance. This comprehensive suite also includes specialized technical services like in-field design and computer-aided design (CAD). HWNI's diverse clientele includes software and hardware original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cable broadband multiple system operators (MSOs), and telecommunications OEMs.
